name: What's New, Scooby-Doo?
description: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery, Inc. gang are launched into the 21st century, with new mysteries to solve.

videos.title: There's No Creature Like Snow Creature
videos.overview: When Scooby enters a snowboarding competition with champion Chris Klug, the other snowboarders start disappearing one by one.

videos.title: 3-D Struction
videos.overview: Dinosaurs come to life at a 3D movie house and wreak havoc on a nearby science museum. The gang must use their investigative skills to save the day.

videos.title: Space Ape at the Cape
videos.overview: The gang must stop a shape-shifting alien before NASA's shuttle mission is aborted.

videos.title: Big Scare in the Big Easy
videos.overview: Ghosts re-enact a duel every night in a New Orleans graveyard.

videos.title: It's Mean, It's Green, It's the Mystery Machine
videos.overview: The Scooby gang are disturbed to find that their van has taken on a life of its own. The gang must try to stop the mystery machine as soon as possible.

videos.title: Riva Ras Regas
videos.overview: Members of the gang investigate claims that the ghost of a magician is haunting the concert hall where their friend is playing.

videos.title: Roller Ghoster Ride
videos.overview: The gang visits an amusement park that is haunted by the Roller Ghoster, a speed-happy spectre that frightens customers away from the fast rides.

videos.title: Safari, So Goodie!
videos.overview: The gang follows Daphne to Africa in search of disappearing wildlife. The sudden appearance of animal demons pushes their plan completely off track.

videos.title: She Sees Sea Monsters by the Sea Shore
videos.overview: The gang attempts to have a relaxing vacation but abandons their plans when a scaly sea serpent surfaces.

videos.title: A Scooby-Doo! Christmas
videos.overview: A perfect ski vacation heads downhill in Winter Hollow, any mention of Christmas unleashes the feared headless snowman. Scooby-Doo and crew set out to melt the ferocious Frosty and save the holiday.

videos.title: Toy Scary Boo
videos.overview: The Scooby Gang travels the 21st century in their Mystery Machine. A simple trip to the mall turns into another mystery when toys come to life.

videos.title: Lights! Camera! Mayhem!
videos.overview: Scooby and the others go behind the scenes, posing as stunt doubles to flush out the ghost of a teen idol haunting a Hollywood movie studio.

videos.title: Pompeii and Circumstance
videos.overview: While visiting Italy, the gang battles a zombie gladiator who appears to be responsible for causing volcano eruptions.

videos.title: The Unnatural
videos.overview: The gang investigate the appearance of a ghostly ex-baseball player who has warned against ace batsman Luis Santiago trying to break his record.

videos.title: Big Appetite in Little Tokyo
videos.overview: Velma wins a science fair with her Dogbot and is awarded a trip to Tokyo, where Shaggy is cursed to turn into a gigantic monster while he sleeps.

videos.title: Mummy Scares Best
videos.overview: The gang travel to Egypt to help their friend with an archaeological dig. However, a mummy's spell turns Fred, Daphne and Velma into zombies.

videos.title: The Fast and the Wormious
videos.overview: In Mexico, Scooby and the gang try to stop a giant sandworm from wreaking havoc on the Enduro Slam 5000 off-road race.

videos.title: High-Tech House of Horrors
videos.overview: The gang visit a fair to see the inventions of the future. However, while inside the `House of Tomorrow' exhibition Daphne mysteriously vanishes.

videos.title: The Vampire Strikes Back
videos.overview: The gang visit the hex girls at a Transylvanian castle and run into a real-life vampire. Though they're scared, they attempt to find out the truth behind the vampire.

videos.title: A Scooby-Doo Halloween
videos.overview: The gang visits Velma's relatives during a Halloween festival headlined by KISS, but the festivities are interrupted by the ghost of the town's founder.

videos.title: Homeward Hound
videos.overview: The Secret Six puppies are dog-napped from the dog show, and it is up to Scooby and the gang to rescue them with their investigative skills.

videos.title: The San Franpsycho
videos.overview: While attending the Grind Games, the gang runs into the ghost of an Alcatraz prisoner who is targeting members of the competition.

videos.title: Simple Plan and the Invisible Madman
videos.overview: While travelling to the Montreal Rock Festival, Scooby and company rescue the band Simple Plan from an invisible madman.

videos.title: Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: When Shaggy wins a trip to the Scooby Snack Factory, the gang prepare for a well-deserved holiday. Unfortunately, the ghost of a former employee is lurking in the shadows.

videos.title: Large Dragon at Large
videos.overview: The gang visits a renaissance fair but gets overwhelmed by a dragon.

videos.title: Uncle Scooby and Antarctica
videos.overview: When the gang heads to Antarctica to return a baby penguin to the wild, they discover a scientist frozen in ice... and a fish-man creature.

videos.title: New Mexico, Old Monster
videos.overview: The gang visits Shaggy's friend Jimmy Proudwolf (and his dog Shooby) and soon discover a gigantic bird terrorizing the New Mexico skies.

videos.title: It's All Greek to Scooby
videos.overview: Scooby and the gang find a medallion while in Greece and are pursued by a centaur who's after the medallion.

videos.title: Fright House of a Lighthouse
videos.overview: Residents of a small Midwestern town are frightened when an abandoned lighthouse is haunted. The Scooby gang come to their rescue with their detective skills.

videos.title: Go West, Young Scoob
videos.overview: The gang travels to a western town where the majority of the residents are robots.

videos.title: A Scooby-Doo Valentine
videos.overview: Local teenagers are being kidnapped by doppelgangers of the gang. Shaggy discovers his ex-girlfriend is dating J.C. Chasez.

videos.title: Wrestle Maniacs
videos.overview: A weird wrestler known as Titanic Twist with two arms on one side is terrorizing wresting matches.

videos.title: Ready to Scare
videos.overview: The gang go to Paris to see Daphne's cousin become Model of the Year, but when they get there, they find out that she's been abducted by a giant gargoyle!

videos.title: Farmed and Dangerous
videos.overview: Scooby and the gang visit the secret six puppies on their farm only to discover it is being haunted by a demon farmer.

videos.title: Diamonds Are a Ghoul's Best Friend
videos.overview: When the gang goes to Russia to watch the Moscow Invitational Hockey Tournament, they encounter a ghostly hockey player known as The Frozen Fiend.

videos.title: A Terrifying Round with a Menacing Metallic Clown
videos.overview: When Shaggy competes in a mini-golf tournament that is terrorised by a giant, metallic clown, the gang must find a way to save the tournament.

videos.title: Camp Comeoniwannascareya
videos.overview: A monster known as The Toxic Terror is attacking the favourite camping ground of Shaggy, Scooby and 3 kids.

videos.title: Block-Long Hong Kong Terror
videos.overview: A trip to Hong Kong turns into yet another mystery for the gang to solve when a huge Chinese New Year dragon suddenly comes to life.

videos.title: Gentlemen, Start Your Monsters
videos.overview: The Mystery Kids head for a NASCAR-like championship race where mayhem is taking place on the racetracks.

videos.title: Gold Paw
videos.overview: Scooby-Doo and the gang visit the Holy Six, where they encounter a monster who turns people to gold. When one of the six becomes prey, the gang must act fast.

videos.title: Reef Grief!
videos.overview: The gang investigate the International Sand Building Competition where a strange coral monster has appeared from the Great Barrier Reef to scare the contestants.

videos.title: E-Scream
videos.overview: The gang visits a video game convention to play the video games, but the cute Osomon creatures that were the highlight of the show turn into monsters.

country: United States, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Thailand
